#include <iostream>
#include <vector>
#include <queue>
#include <cstring>
#include <algorithm>

using namespace std;

class InputReader {
public:
    InputReader(istream& stream) : stream(stream) {}

    int nextInt() {
        int x = 0, sign = 1;
        char c = nextChar();
        while (c == ' ' || c == '\n' || c == '\r' || c == '\t') {
            c = nextChar();
        }
        if (c == '-') {
            sign = -1;
            c = nextChar();
        }
        while (c >= '0' && c <= '9') {
            x = x * 10 + (c - '0');
            c = nextChar();
        }
        return x * sign;
    }

private:
    istream& stream;

    char nextChar() {
        char c;
        stream.get(c);
        return c;
    }
};

class OutputWriter {
public:
    OutputWriter(ostream& stream) : stream(stream) {}

    void println(long long x) {
        stream << x << endl;
    }

private:
    ostream& stream;
};

class HopcroftKarpBipartiteMatching {
public:
    int m, n;
    vector<vector<int>> g;
    vector<int> pairU, pairV, dis;
    const int INF = 10000000;
    const int NIL = 0;

    HopcroftKarpBipartiteMatching(int m, int n, vector<vector<int>>& g) : m(m), n(n), g(g) {
        pairU.assign(m + 1, NIL);
        pairV.assign(n + 1, NIL);
        dis.assign(m + 1, 0);
    }

    int maximumMatching() {
        fill(pairU.begin(), pairU.end(), NIL);
        fill(pairV.begin(), pairV.end(), NIL);
        int maxMatching = 0;

        while (bfs()) {
            for (int i = 1; i <= m; i++) {
                if (pairU[i] == NIL && dfs(i)) {
                    maxMatching++;
                }
            }
        }

        return maxMatching;
    }

    bool bfs() {
        queue<int> q;

        for (int i = 1; i <= m; i++) {
            if (pairU[i] == NIL) {
                q.push(i);
                dis[i] = 0;
            } else {
                dis[i] = INF;
            }
        }

        dis[NIL] = INF;

        while (!q.empty()) {
            int u = q.front();
            q.pop();

            if (dis[u] < dis[NIL]) {
                for (int v : g[u]) {
                    if (dis[pairV[v]] == INF) {
                        q.push(pairV[v]);
                        dis[pairV[v]] = dis[u] + 2;
                    }
                }
            }
        }

        return dis[NIL] < INF;
    }

    bool dfs(int u) {
        if (u != NIL) {
            for (int v : g[u]) {
                if (dis[pairV[v]] == dis[u] + 2) {
                    if (dfs(pairV[v])) {
                        pairV[v] = u;
                        pairU[u] = v;
                        return true;
                    }
                }
            }
            dis[u] = INF;
            return false;
        } else {
            return true;
        }
    }
};

int main() {
    InputReader in(cin);
    OutputWriter out(cout);

    int n, m;
    n = in.nextInt();
    m = in.nextInt();

    long long ans = 0;

    if (n > 100) {
        int nn = (n - 100) % 6;
        long long nq = (n - 100) / 6;
        ans += nq * 6 * m;
        n = 100 + nn;
    }

    if (m > 100) {
        int nm = (m - 100) % 6;
        long long mq = (m - 100) / 6;
        ans += mq * 6 * n;
        m = 100 + nm;
    }

    vector<vector<int>> mat(n + 1, vector<int>(m + 1, 0));
    int u = 1, v = 1;

    for (int i = 1; i <= n; i++) {
        for (int j = 1; j <= m; j++) {
            if ((i + j) % 2 == 0) {
                mat[i][j] = u;
                u++;
            }
        }
    }

    for (int i = 1; i <= n; i++) {
        for (int j = 1; j <= m; j++) {
            if ((i + j) % 2 != 0) {
                mat[i][j] = v;
                v++;
            }
        }
    }

    vector<vector<int>> g(u);
    vector<pair<int,int>> moves = {
        {-3, 0}, {-2, -1}, {-2, 1}, {0, -3}, {-1, -2}, {1, -2},
        {0, 3}, {-1, 2}, {1, 2}, {3, 0}, {2, -1}, {2, 1}
    };

    for (int i = 1; i <= n; i++) {
        for (int j = 1; j <= m; j++) {
            if ((i + j) % 2 == 0) {
                for (auto& mv : moves) {
                    int s = i + mv.first;
                    int t = j + mv.second;
                    if (s >= 1 && s <= n && t >= 1 && t <= m) {
                        g[mat[i][j]].push_back(mat[s][t]);
                    }
                }
            }
        }
    }

    HopcroftKarpBipartiteMatching bpm(u - 1, v - 1, g);
    ans += 2 * bpm.maximumMatching();
    out.println(ans);

    return 0;
}
